summary: Frontend-only testing of Pro Photo Sorter iteration 11 (destination tree hover actions + Image Editor 'Done' button). Did static code review of TreeNode.jsx / FileTree.jsx / ImageEditor.jsx / App.js, plus runtime Playwright testing at the public URL. Because the FSA directory picker cannot be automated, I injected a mock window.showDirectoryPicker (in-memory directory/file handles with entries/getDirectoryHandle/removeEntry/createWritable) via add_init_script, which allowed full runtime exercise of the new tree edit handlers AND the editor Done flow. All new features pass; 0 console/page errors in every run.
critical_code_review_comments: renameDestFolder does removeEntry(oldName) then getDirectoryHandle(safe, {create:true}); if the create step throws (e.g. invalid/duplicate name after sanitization) the original folder is already gone — consider creating the new folder first, then removing the old one.
App.js is 1352 lines; consider splitting handlers (tree housekeeping, store/undo, rename/contact-sheet) into hooks/modules for maintainability.

TreeNode refreshCounter effect only refreshes branches where branchHasStore is true; handlers work around this by writing a 0-count justStored entry. Works, but it is implicit coupling — a dedicated 'dirtyPaths' set would be clearer.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data. Ephemeral in-browser mock FSA handles (MockDest with EmptyFolder/FullFolder, MockSrc with photo1.jpg/photo2.jpg) injected per test run only.
verified_pass_list: App loads at public URL, 0 console errors / 0 page errors across 3 runs.

Toolbar regression: open-editor, compare-1/2/3, auto-rate-btn, open-rename, open-contact, open-category-manager, toggle-batch, open-settings, show-help all present & visible. No COPY/MOVE text (iter 8 removal intact).
help-modal and settings-modal open on click and close on Escape (note: modals use data-testid, not role=dialog).
TreeNode: root node (depth 0) renders ONLY tree-add-<path>; subfolders render tree-add/tree-rename/tree-delete. Hover reveal via group-hover works at runtime (verified visible only on hover).
FileTree forwards editable/onCreateSubfolder/onRenameFolder/onDeleteFolder + parentHandle={null}; destination FileTree passes editable, source FileTree does not (read-only) — confirmed in App.js.
Runtime create subfolder: prompt accepted 'New Kids' -> sanitized to New_Kids, success toast, node appears in tree (destRefreshCounter refresh works).
Runtime delete non-empty folder: 'Folder is not empty' error toast, no deletion, no confirm shown.
Runtime delete empty folder: window.confirm accepted -> 'Deleted' toast, node removed from tree.
Runtime rename empty folder: prompt 'Renamed One' -> 'Renamed to "Renamed_One"' toast, old node gone, new node present.
ImageEditor: editor-done button present next to editor-save, green (rgb(122,144,115) = bg-success-earth), enabled when image loaded.
Done with NO edits: shows 'No changes to save' toast and closes editor back to sorting window (no file written).
Done WITH edits (brightness +30): saves new file photo1_edit_<timestamp>.jpg (createWritable called once), closes editor, filmstrip refreshes and selects the new file.
Escape still closes the Image Editor.
context_for_next_testing_agent: FSA picker automation trick: inject window.showDirectoryPicker via page.add_init_script returning a mock directory handle implementing async *entries(), getDirectoryHandle(name,{create}), getFileHandle(name,{create}), removeEntry(name), and for files getFile()/createWritable(). This enables full runtime testing of tree + editor + store flows. window.prompt/confirm handled with page.once('dialog', d => d.accept('name')). Toasts auto-dismiss in ~4s, so assert on toast text within ~2s of the action. Modals expose data-testid (help-modal, settings-modal), not role=dialog.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects found in iteration 11 scope.
